build_DAobjTwoStagePseudoLabGeneralizedR: build a domain adaptation two-stage pseudo-label GeneralizedRCNN model from a Detectron2 config
build_TwoStagePseudoLabGeneralizedRCNN: build a two-stage pseudo-label GeneralizedRCNN model for supervised and unsupervised training branches
build_FCDiscriminator_img: build a fully connected image discriminator with configurable convolutional layers for domain classification
use_grad_reverse: use the gradient reverse function to negate gradients during backpropagation for domain adaptation
run_DAobjTwoStagePseudoLabGeneralizedRCN: run the domain adaptation RCNN forward pass with supervised, unsupervised, or domain branches
